rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: American Heritage ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Walter E. Lammerts (United States, before 1965).
Introduced in United States by Germain's (Germain Seed & Plant Co.) in 1965 as 'American Heritage'.
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 1966 as 'American Heritage'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 1967 as 'American Heritage'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, salmon-pink blending, ages to salmon-pink . Mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit: Tall, bushy. Glossy, dark green, leathery foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 2,687 on 29 Nov 1966 VIEW USPTO PATENT
